title: Goal Misgeneralization Hidden in SAE Dark Matter: Control Fails at Deployment Distribution

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Goal misgeneralization is a canonical alignment failure mode. Testing whether SAE-based interpretability can detect which goal a model pursues is a direct test of interpretability's core alignment utility. The finding either way is highly informative.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Constructing a goal misgeneralization scenario from scratch, training a model with two coinciding goals, training SAEs, and probing for goal representations is a multi-step project requiring RL or supervised fine-tuning expertise. Very challenging for beginners in 30 hours.
